title: GPT-5.6: from model release to operating model

beats.title: GPT-5.6 launched as a three-tier family
beats.body: The release introduces Sol, Terra, and Luna for different capability, cost, and latency needs.

beats.title: The family reaches three product surfaces
beats.body: OpenAI lists availability across ChatGPT, Codex, and the OpenAI API.

beats.title: Model choice becomes routing policy
beats.body: Teams can reserve Sol for ambiguous work, use Terra for balanced implementation, and route bounded checks to Luna.

beats.title: Evidence and approvals make routing operational
beats.body: A production workflow binds factual sources, style evidence, timing, QA, and final approval to exact artifacts.

beats.title: The release matters when the workflow changes
beats.body: The decision is not only which model to call, but which evidence and control gates surround each class of work.
